🪔 DIWALI UNPLUGGED 🪔
Live Bollywood Band ft. Five Strings✨ Presented by Tamasha Nights × Juhi Productions × PG Luxora
Celebrate the festival of lights with an unforgettable night of live Bollywood music, festive vibes, and an electrifying afterparty!
Join us at Panash Lounge in New Brunswick, New Jersey, for DIWALI UNPLUGGED, featuring Five Strings — a live Bollywood band bringing your favorite melodies to life. Get ready to sing along, celebrate with friends, and experience the magic of Diwali through the power of live music.
📅 Friday, November 13
⏰ Starting at 7:00 PM
📍 Panash Lounge, New Brunswick, NJ

🎶 THE NIGHT UNFOLDS🎸 Live Bollywood Band ft. Five Strings
Experience an incredible live performance filled with Bollywood favorites, soulful melodies, and energetic beats. Whether you love timeless classics or modern Bollywood hits, Five Strings will set the perfect mood for a memorable Diwali celebration.
✨ Celebrate Diwali in Style
Enjoy a festive atmosphere, great music, and an unforgettable night with friends and family as we celebrate the festival of lights together.

🔥 THE PARTY CONTINUES!
FREE ACCESS TO THE BOLLYWOOD AFTERPARTY ft. DJ BROWNY 🎧The live music is just the beginning! Keep the celebration going as DJ Browny takes over with your favorite Bollywood hits, desi beats, and party anthems.
🪩 Dance the night away and celebrate Diwali with an energetic Bollywood party — your access to the Bollywood afterparty is FREE!
